lines.trans: I am a hopeless man. All by myself I cannot do a single thing.
I'm no support to anyone—just a pig whose entire staff ran out on him!
I'm searching for a new form of erotica, though I'm still in the middle of trial and error.
Why not just make ordinary videos?
I've had more than enough of those. I'm tired of them.

words.gloss: got tired of, grew bored with

lines.trans: Hey, want me to tell you the formula that sells?
Even if it won't be a mega-hit, it's a surefire bet if you stick to it.
With ordinary stuff, I just can't get excited anymore.
Good evening, President!
Oh, so you're here too, Mr. Chu.
I brought another great item for you. Allow me to carry it to your place.
No need to bring anything. Quit being so pushy.
